desktop.notesZh: 批次二十一（暗色模式「共享部件白底」根治 + 亮暗双主题真机核验，web 端真机探针 41 项断言全 PASS）：① 根因——客户端 CSS 写的是 `var(--dsw-alias-bg-canvas, #f6f8fb)`、`var(--dsw-alias-text-primary, #1f2937)` 这类链式兜底，而这些 `--dsw-alias-*` 在设计平台里从未定义，于是每一处都落回浅色字面量：暗色下共享部件（FlowCanvas / ArtifactRail / StageChecklist / BilingualDetail）与变更详情四区工作区仍是白底 + 近黑墨色。本次在设计平台补齐 14 枚缺失别名（bg-canvas / bg-elevated / bg-primary / text-primary / text-secondary / text-tertiary / text-success / text-danger / text-warning / text-info / border-subtle / border-strong / state-danger-label / attention），亮暗双份，一次点亮 10 个包 432 处使用；状态色按文案对比度混色（成功 4.7:1 / 警告 5.9:1 / 危险 5.3:1 on white），暗色取亮端（green-400 / red-400 / amber-400 / blue-400）。② BAF 金色改为本地 token 并给出暗色半值（#c9a227 → #d9b64c），会话工作流图 / 测试流图 / 变更总览 / 确认门 / 企业规范流程图五处共用同一套 `--wf-*` / `--qf-accent` 词表——此前会话侧「停靠门」用紫色、变更详情侧用琥珀，同一含义两套颜色且都不随主题切换，本批统一为琥珀并去掉 BAF 面上最后一处紫色。③ 确认门问答弹窗金面文案由「主题抬升色」改为固定深墨（白字在金上仅 2.4:1），亮暗两态均 9.9:1。④ 追踪图保留自有靛紫品牌但改为亮暗双值（#8250df → #a78bfa），表面与描边随主题。⑤ 真机核验：亮色共享卡片仍为白面 + 18.9:1 对比度；暗色整页零白盒，共享卡片 #2c2c2e 抬升于 #151517 画布之上、对比度 13.34:1；会话工作流图 / 会话测试流图 / 确认门 / 测试流 / 变更总览 / 变更详情工作区六个界面双主题逐帧审查通过。
desktop.notesEn: Batch 21 (dark-theme white-box fix for the shared workflow parts, verified live in BOTH themes — 41 web assertions, all PASS): (1) Root cause: the client CSS chained fallbacks such as `var(--dsw-alias-bg-canvas, #f6f8fb)` and `var(--dsw-alias-text-primary, #1f2937)` against aliases the design platform never defined, so every chain resolved to its LIGHT literal — in the dark theme the shared parts (FlowCanvas / ArtifactRail / StageChecklist / BilingualDetail) and the change-detail workspace stayed white with near-black copy. The platform now defines the 14 missing aliases (bg-canvas / bg-elevated / bg-primary / text-primary / text-secondary / text-tertiary / text-success / text-danger / text-warning / text-info / border-subtle / border-strong / state-danger-label / attention) for both themes, lighting up 432 call sites across 10 packages; the status colours are mixed for copy contrast (success 4.7:1, warning 5.9:1, danger 5.3:1 on white) and take the bright palette end in the dark theme. (2) The BAF gold is a local token with a dark half (#c9a227 → #d9b64c) shared by the session workflow graph, the test-flow graph, the change ledger, the gates page and the enterprise-standard flow — the session parked gate used violet while the change-detail workspace used amber for one meaning; both are amber now and the last violet is gone from the BAF surface. (3) Copy on the gate composer's gold is a fixed dark ink (white on gold was 2.4:1) — 9.9:1 in both themes. (4) The trace graph keeps its own indigo brand but now switches (#8250df → #a78bfa) with its surfaces. (5) Live verification: in light the shared card is still the white surface at 18.9:1; in dark there is NO white box on any of the six surfaces, the shared card is #2c2c2e raised over the #151517 canvas at 13.34:1.
